description:
Arcadia is the most trusted healthcare platform powering outcomes. We transform complex healthcare data into trusted intelligence, helping providers, payers, and life sciences organizations act with clarity, make confident decisions, and achieve measurable clinical, operational, and financial outcomes. 

Built on a comprehensive data foundation spanning tens of millions of patient lives, Arcadia combines advanced analytics and responsible AI to surface meaningful insights, coordinate action, and improve performance at scale. Our approach to AI and automation is governed and transparent — designed to strengthen human expertise, not replace judgment or obscure responsibility. 

Hundreds of organizations rely on Arcadia to improve cost, quality, and outcomes. Backed by Nordic Capital, we continue to invest in our platform, AI capabilities, and people as we pursue our purpose: helping healthcare deliver better outcomes for every person, every community, and every generation. 

Why This Role Is Important to Arcadia

Arcadia is expanding its leadership in advanced alternative payment models (APMs), including total cost of care models (e.g., MSSP, LEAD, AHEAD) and episodic models (e.g., ASM, CJR-X, TEAM). This role is a hands-on builder for Arcadia’s APM solutions products, helping ensure technical rigor and financial accuracy as we develop and implement APM solutions for our most strategic engagements. 

What You’ll Be Doing

APM Solution Development 

  • Support financial modeling for CMS total cost of care and episodic APMs. 
  • Translate CMS technical specifications into production-grade models. 
  • Develop and maintain benchmark, attribution, risk adjustment, and reconciliation logic. 
  • Contribute to APM product development, implementing and testing the financial logic that goes into Arcadia’s platform. 

    • CMS Data & Technical Execution 

  • Work directly with CMS VRDC data environments to extract, structure, and analyze Medicare claims and enrollment data. 
  • Write production-level SAS and Python code to: 
  • Process large claims datasets 
  • Facilitate risk-adjustments 
  • Calculate, risk adjust, and project PMPM benchmarks 
  • Run sensitivity testing 
  • Conduct reconciliation and true-up calculations 
  • Ensure compliance with CMS methodological guidance. 
  • Validate data integrity prior to model production. 

    • Quality & Validation 

  • Create automated testing scripts and exception reporting to implement validation checks, parallel runs, and reconciliation frameworks. 
  • Maintain version control, documentation, and auditability of all models at a sufficiently robust level to enable audits or CMS review. 

    • What Success Looks Like

    In 3 months 

  • Develop working knowledge of CMS total cost of care and episodic model methodology and financial mechanics. 
  • Gain hands-on access to VRDC data sources and Arcadia’s data ingestion processes. 
  • Understand existing Arcadia APM calculation logic and identify improvement opportunities. 

    • In 6 months 

  • Independently own defined components of Arcadia’s CMS APM solutions. 
  • Develop APM model financial calculations and underwriting framework in collaboration with actuaries 
  • Build reproducible, well-documented SAS pipelines for: 
  • Benchmark construction 
  • Risk score development and normalization 
  • Trend and PMPM projections 
  • Savings/loss simulations 
  • Implement multi-layer QA and reconciliation procedures. 

    • In 12 months 

  • Deliver production-ready, validated model outputs for Arcadia’s APM products. 
  • Contribute to the product roadmap so actuarial precision is built into platform design. 
  • Be recognized as a leader/go-to resource for APM financial modeling. 

    • What You’ll Bring

    Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Actuarial Science, Finance, Mathematics) 
  • Strong SAS and SQL fluency, with a minimum of 5 years of experience in healthcare  
  • Experience working with Medicare claims data 
  • Strong accountability, intellectual curiosity, and exceptional attention to detail 
  • Experience with database querying (SAS, SQL) 

    • Preferred

  • Familiarity and experience modeling/evaluating CMMI value-based care and APM models 
  • Actuarial experience or experience supporting actuaries with CMS/CMMI models 
  • Experience working within the VRDC environment 
  • Consulting experience with deadline-driven project management and clear communication of complex, technical topics to health plan or provider stakeholders 
  • Actuarial modeling and episode measurement 

    • How Level Shapes the Role 

    Senior Analyst (5+ years): Independently owns end-to-end components of APM solutions, and partners directly with actuaries and product on methodology. 

    Manager (5+ years): Owns APM solutions end to end, sets coding and validation standards, and serves as the subject matter expert in customer and executive discussions. 

    What You'll Get

  • Direct access to one of the industry’s largest and most comprehensive healthcare data assets to support groundbreaking actuarial work. 
  • A mission-driven company working to improve how patients receive care 
  • A flexible, remote-friendly culture with personality and heart 
  • Employee-driven programs and initiatives for personal and professional development 
  • Membership in the talented, energized, diverse, and purpose-driven Arcadian community 

    • Protect Yourself

    If you have concerns about the authenticity of a job offer or recruitment-related communication claiming to be from Arcadia, verify it by calling us directly at (781) 202-3600 and selecting option 3. You can find more information at Arcadia. 

    PHI Clause

    In this role, you are responsible for following all security policies and procedures to protect all PHI under Arcadia’s custodianship, as well as Arcadia intellectual property. For security-specific roles, the hiring manager defines any additional responsibilities. 

    Non-Discrimination Statement

    Arcadia does not discriminate based on race, color, sex (including pregnancy and related conditions, sexual orientation, or transgender status), national origin, religion, age (40 and older), equal pay, disability or genetic information (including family medical history or genetic tests or services), or retaliation for filing a charge, reasonably opposing discrimination, or participating in a discrimination lawsuit, investigation, or proceeding.
